nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the main phenomenon caused by population outbreaks of COTS?
nodes.answer: Population outbreaks of COTS cause major coral loss in Indo-Pacific reefs.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Life below water|Coral reef protection|Coral disease control_qna_001
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What is the potential role of cohorts of juveniles in the reef infrastructure?
nodes.answer: Cohorts of juveniles can accumulate as a hidden army in the reef infrastructure, potentially serving as a proximate source of outbreaks during suitable conditions.
